name: Ougai Masahiko
source:
Former T University professor and is said to be Saya's father. Ougai disappeared after resigning following a scandal at the hospital.

Ryouko had tried to find him in the past to no avail.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saya_no_Uta]Wikipedia[/url]]
